title: A Tryouts for the Yearbook
author: Odile Winterbourne
blurb: Theo Ishikawa, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
